name: stall_width_m
where: Ch. D, Table 3 p.25; Table 9 p.35
note: Standard 90-degree stall width at service level 1 (pairs with a 5.80 m aisle).

name: stall_depth_m
note: Minimum 90-degree stall length: 4.75 m design car + 0.25 m.

name: aisle_width_m
where: Ch. D, Table 3 p.25; Sec. 13.3 p.60
note: Two-way aisle for 2.50 m stalls at service level 1.

name: ramp_max_grade
note: Maximum ramp gradient at service levels 1-2 (17% at level 3).

name: ramp_transition_m
note: Each end of the ramp has a 3 m transition at half the gradient.

name: floor_rise_m
note: No Israeli figure found; MoT only gives 2.20 m clear height. US garages are typically 3.2-3.5 m floor to floor, per PURINTON2012.

name: search_speed_kmh
note: MoT design assumption for driving inside a parking facility (a design value, not a measurement). Shoup (2006) observed ~13 km/h while cruising on-street.

name: fuel_rate_l_per_h
note: Measured idle consumption 0.279 cc/s = 1.0 L/h (2.5 L sedan); passenger cars 0.76-1.9 L/h. At crawl speed, consumption is modelled per hour, not per km.

name: co2_kg_per_l
note: 8,887 g CO2 per gallon of gasoline.

name: fuel_price_ils_per_l
note: 95-octane self-service, October 2026, including VAT.

name: value_of_time_ils_per_h
note: Value of travel time for non-work trips (2020 prices); parking search counts as travel time (p.115).

name: mean_stay_min
note: Mall garage: gamma-distributed stays with means 82.5-93.7 min.

name: stay_gamma_shape
note: Reported gamma shapes 1.12-2.53; mid-range value chosen.

name: target_occupancy
note: Search effort becomes noticeable above ~85% occupancy and important above 92-93%.

name: operating_hours_per_day
note: Typical mall opening hours (10:00-22:00); only used to turn per-car savings into yearly totals.

name: garage_floors
note: Main scenario: a representative small multi-storey garage.

name: garage_aisles_per_floor
note: Parallel two-way aisles per floor, stalls on both sides, cross aisles at both ends.

name: garage_rows_per_aisle
note: 12 stalls per side = 30 m aisles; 3 floors x 3 aisles x 2 sides x 12 = 216 stalls.

name: search_visibility_p
note: Chance that a searching driver notices a free stall they pass. 1.0 = sees every one, the most favourable case for the driver, so the system's savings are a lower bound.

name: reservation_timeout_s
note: Demo value. Real-world bound: farthest spot / search speed + parking manoeuvre margin.
